summary: No installer-side threat identified in tailwindcss-animate-catalog@2.0.6
details: Examination of the tailwindcss-animate-catalog@2.0.6 npm package surfaced no evidence of installer-harming behavior. No lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content, no credential or environment-variable exfiltration, no hardcoded attacker endpoints, no obfuscated payloads, and no silent-relay or backdoor mechanisms were observed. The package appears to be a Tailwind CSS animation utility with no code paths that would compromise a developer or build system upon installation or import.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
